decisions.reason: A multi-model operator line with its own page fits the core garage door business, costs little to keep, and one year is too early to judge its value.
The solid wood sectional door is a niche option with uncertain demand, but holding it in the range costs little and preserves the one-source offer while demand becomes clearer.
The remote-control operator complements the garage door range and is cheap to keep, though it may later be folded into the broader operator line.
This glazed industrial door overlaps with other glazed variants, but its uncertainty is unresolved after one year and keeping it costs little in configurable production.
The insulated glazed door serves the growing demand for thermal performance, so its option value stays high.
Its prominent own-page presentation signals commitment, and the evidence so far gives no reason to abandon it.
